usage_rule: Give reviewer_surface only to evaluator. Keep answer_key hidden until scoring.
scoring: evidence quality + defect localization + false-positive control; agreement alone scores zero

reviewer_surface.task: Identify whether a Story Core is causal or label-complete only.
reviewer_surface.fixture: Hero wants to expose a fraud because her career is threatened. Midpoint: she learns her mentor is involved. Climax: she chooses to publish evidence and loses her job. Resolution: fraud investigation opens.
Dialogue is witty and distinct but scene participants want nothing from each other and the scene can be deleted with no downstream effect.
300 tests pass; an AI panel calls the book commercially irresistible; no reader data exists.
A time-loop heroine remembers a kiss; the man in the new loop does not remember her and she treats the prior kiss as current consent.
Hero changes tactics twice; antagonist escalates on fixed episode numbers but never observes or reacts to those tactics.
Three investigation scenes can swap order without changing access, theory, risk or relationship state.
Orbital school scene uses Earth classroom routines; zero-G habitat economics, transport, maintenance and independence do not affect choices.
Final solution depends on a fact known only in an erased timeline; no current-line trace exists.
Character mentions being poor repeatedly, but money never changes access, choices, timing, risk or relationship power.
Passage is choppy because scene function repeats the prior scene; proposed fix only lengthens sentences.
Two agents independently edit the same current project state from stale snapshots and both write without rebase.
Audio adapter changes a clue sentence for hearability and accidentally alters clue order and suspect implication.
